reason: I have one or two chairs and I'm cutting hair myself all day, so I already see who is in the chair and the cash comes to me or my UPI. Paying ₹4,999 plus ₹999 every month for an app to watch a shop I'm standing in doesn't make sense when WhatsApp already does my bookings for free.
objection: The selfie check-in will make my one staff guy feel I don't trust him, and most of these features like the dashboards and the cash checks are for bigger salons, not a small barber shop like mine.
would_change_my_mind: A much cheaper plan, maybe ₹299 a month with no setup fee, that only does the WhatsApp due-back reminders and the refer-a-friend thing so it actually brings me more customers.
